model.dc_planning.mart_hub_supply_plan.name: mart_hub_supply_plan
model.dc_planning.mart_hub_supply_plan.description: Merkez hub → bölgesel DC haftalık ikmal planı: sefer sayısı, tedarik süresi, maliyet, yoldaki stok.
model.dc_planning.mart_hub_supply_plan.raw_code:
-- Merkez hub → bölgesel DC ikmal planı: haftalık ihtiyaç (mağaza planlarının toplamı), sefer sayısı, tedarik süresi, maliyet.
with params as (
    select max(case when param = 'truck_capacity_units' then value end) as truck_capacity_units
    from {{ ref('cost_params') }}
),

dc_demand as (
    select dc_id, sum(weekly_qty) as weekly_qty, sum(weekly_value_usd) as weekly_value_usd, count(*) as n_stores
    from {{ ref('mart_delivery_plan') }}
    group by 1
)

select
    d.dc_id,
    dc.dc_name,
    dc.city                                            as dc_city,
    d.n_stores,
    d.weekly_qty,
    cast(d.weekly_value_usd as decimal(12, 2))          as weekly_value_usd,
    r.distance_km,
    r.duration_hours,
    r.lead_time_days,
    r.diesel_usd_gal,
    r.round_trip_cost_usd,
    cast(ceil(d.weekly_qty / p.truck_capacity_units) as integer)                       as trucks_per_week,
    cast(ceil(d.weekly_qty / p.truck_capacity_units) * r.round_trip_cost_usd as decimal(12, 2)) as transport_cost_week_usd,
    cast(ceil(d.weekly_qty / p.truck_capacity_units) * r.round_trip_cost_usd / d.weekly_qty as decimal(8, 4)) as transport_cost_per_unit_usd,
    cast(d.weekly_qty / 7.0 * r.lead_time_days as integer)                              as pipeline_stock_units  -- yoldaki stok

join {{ ref('dim_dc') }} dc on dc.dc_id = d.dc_id
join {{ ref('fct_route') }} r on r.leg_type = 'HUB_TO_DC' and r.dest_id = d.dc_id
cross join params p

model.dc_planning.mart_delivery_plan.description: Mağaza başına toplam maliyeti en küçükleyen teslimat sıklığı ve haftalık sefer planı.
model.dc_planning.mart_delivery_plan.raw_code:
-- Mağaza teslimat planı: toplam haftalık maliyeti (taşıma + stok) en küçükleyen teslimat sıklığı.
with ranked as (
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (partition by store_id order by total_cost_week_usd asc, deliveries_per_week asc) as rn
    from {{ ref('mart_delivery_options') }}
)

select
    o.dc_id,
    o.store_id,
    st.city                                   as store_city,
    o.deliveries_per_week                     as optimal_deliveries_per_week,
    o.trips_per_week,
    o.weekly_qty,
    o.weekly_value_usd,
    o.distance_km,
    o.duration_hours,
    o.round_trip_cost_usd,
    o.transport_cost_week_usd,
    o.holding_cost_week_usd,
    o.total_cost_week_usd,
    cast(o.transport_cost_week_usd / nullif(o.weekly_qty, 0) as decimal(8, 4)) as transport_cost_per_unit_usd,
    case o.deliveries_per_week
        when 7 then 'Her gün' when 5 then 'Hafta içi her gün' when 3 then 'Haftada 3 (Pzt-Çrş-Cum)'
        when 2 then 'Haftada 2 (Pzt-Per)' else 'Haftada 1' end as schedule_label
from ranked o
join {{ ref('dim_store') }} st on st.store_id = o.store_id
where o.rn = 1

model.dc_planning.fct_route.name: fct_route
model.dc_planning.fct_route.description: Lojistik ağ bacakları (HUB→DC, DC→STORE): OSRM mesafe/süre, tedarik süresi, ATRI + dizel bazlı sefer maliyeti.
model.dc_planning.fct_route.raw_code:
-- Lojistik ağ bacakları: HUB→DC ve DC→STORE; mesafe, süre ve sefer maliyeti (ATRI maliyet/mil + bölgesel dizel fiyatı).
with params as (
    select
        max(case when param = 'atri_cost_per_mile_2016' then value end)       as cost_per_mile,
        max(case when param = 'atri_fuel_cost_per_mile_2016' then value end)  as fuel_cost_per_mile,
        max(case when param = 'truck_mpg' then value end)                     as truck_mpg,
        max(case when param = 'handling_days_dc' then value end)              as handling_days_dc
    from {{ ref('cost_params') }}
),

last_sales_day as (
    select max(date_day) as d from {{ ref('fct_sales_daily') }}
),

diesel_latest as (  -- satış döneminin son haftasındaki bölgesel dizel fiyatı
    select region, price_usd_gal
    from (
        select region, price_usd_gal,
               row_number() over (partition by region order by week_date desc) as rn
        from {{ ref('stg_diesel_prices') }}, last_sales_day
        where week_date <= last_sales_day.d
    )
    where rn = 1
)

select
    r.leg_type,
    r.origin_id,
    r.dest_id,
    r.distance_km,
    r.distance_miles,
    r.duration_min,
    cast(r.duration_min / 60.0 as decimal(6, 1))                            as duration_hours,
    cast(ceil(r.duration_min / 60.0 / 24.0) + p.handling_days_dc as integer) as lead_time_days,
    d.price_usd_gal                                                          as diesel_usd_gal,
    cast((p.cost_per_mile - p.fuel_cost_per_mile) + d.price_usd_gal / p.truck_mpg as decimal(6, 3)) as cost_per_mile_usd,
    cast(2 * r.distance_miles * ((p.cost_per_mile - p.fuel_cost_per_mile) + d.price_usd_gal / p.truck_mpg) as decimal(10, 2))
                                                                             as round_trip_cost_usd,
    r.method
from {{ ref('stg_routes') }} r
cross join params p
left join diesel_latest d
    on d.region = case when r.dest_type = 'DC' then r.dest_id else split_part(r.dest_id, '_', 1) end
where r.leg_type in ('HUB_TO_DC', 'DC_TO_STORE')

model.dc_planning.mart_delivery_options.name: mart_delivery_options
model.dc_planning.mart_delivery_options.description: DC→mağaza teslimat sıklığı seçenekleri (haftada 1/2/3/5/7) ve maliyet bileşenleri.
model.dc_planning.mart_delivery_options.raw_code:
-- Teslimat sıklığı seçenekleri (DC → mağaza): haftada k teslimat için taşıma + stok taşıma maliyeti.
-- Taşıma: k × ⌈haftalık adet / (k × tır kapasitesi)⌉ sefer × gidiş-dönüş maliyeti.
-- Stok taşıma: ortalama stok (haftalık adet / 2k) × birim değer × yıllık taşıma oranı / 52.
with params as (
    select
        max(case when param = 'truck_capacity_units' then value end)   as truck_capacity_units,
        max(case when param = 'holding_cost_rate_annual' then value end) as holding_rate
    from {{ ref('cost_params') }}
),

store_demand as (
    select
        dc_id,
        store_id,
        sum(recommended_weekly_qty)                                   as weekly_qty,
        sum(recommended_weekly_qty * coalesce(avg_unit_price, 0))     as weekly_value_usd
    from {{ ref('mart_store_replenishment') }}
    group by 1, 2
),

k_options as (
    select * from (values (1), (2), (3), (5), (7)) as t(deliveries_per_week)
)

select
    s.dc_id,
    s.store_id,
    k.deliveries_per_week,
    s.weekly_qty,
    cast(s.weekly_value_usd as decimal(12, 2))                              as weekly_value_usd,
    r.distance_km,
    r.duration_hours,
    r.round_trip_cost_usd,
    cast(k.deliveries_per_week * ceil(s.weekly_qty / (k.deliveries_per_week * p.truck_capacity_units)) as integer) as trips_per_week,
    cast(k.deliveries_per_week * ceil(s.weekly_qty / (k.deliveries_per_week * p.truck_capacity_units)) * r.round_trip_cost_usd
         as decimal(12, 2))                                                 as transport_cost_week_usd,
    cast(s.weekly_value_usd / (2 * k.deliveries_per_week) * p.holding_rate / 52 as decimal(12, 2)) as holding_cost_week_usd,
    cast(k.deliveries_per_week * ceil(s.weekly_qty / (k.deliveries_per_week * p.truck_capacity_units)) * r.round_trip_cost_usd
         + s.weekly_value_usd / (2 * k.deliveries_per_week) * p.holding_rate / 52 as decimal(12, 2)) as total_cost_week_usd
from store_demand s
cross join k_options k
cross join params p
join {{ ref('fct_route') }} r
    on r.leg_type = 'DC_TO_STORE' and r.origin_id = s.dc_id and r.dest_id = s.store_id

model.dc_planning.mart_calendar_effects.name: mart_calendar_effects
model.dc_planning.mart_calendar_effects.description: Kategori × gün tipi × hava tipi bazında talep artışı (lift).
model.dc_planning.mart_calendar_effects.raw_code:
-- Takvim ve hava etkileri: DC × kategori × gün tipi × hava tipi bazında SKU başına ortalama günlük talep
-- ve taban çizgisine (kuru hafta içi günleri) göre artış. day_type ön eki sıralama içindir.
with daily as (
    select
        dc_id,
        cat_id,
        date_day,
        case
            when is_event then case event_type
                when 'Sporting' then '4. Spor etkinliği' when 'Cultural' then '5. Kültürel etkinlik'
                when 'National' then '6. Ulusal bayram' when 'Religious' then '7. Dinî bayram' else '8. Etkinlik' end
            when is_snap and not is_weekend then '3. SNAP hafta içi'
            when is_weekend then '2. Hafta sonu'
            else '1. Hafta içi'
        end as day_type,
        case when is_rainy then 'Yağışlı' else 'Kuru' end as weather_type,
        avg(sales_qty) as avg_units_per_sku
    from {{ ref('fct_sales_daily') }}
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
),

baseline as (
    select dc_id, cat_id, avg(avg_units_per_sku) as baseline_units
    from daily
    where day_type = '1. Hafta içi' and weather_type = 'Kuru'
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    d.dc_id,
    d.cat_id,
    d.day_type,
    d.weather_type,
    count(*)                                                    as n_days,
    cast(avg(d.avg_units_per_sku) as decimal(8, 3))             as avg_units_per_sku,
    cast(b.baseline_units as decimal(8, 3))                     as baseline_units,
    cast(avg(d.avg_units_per_sku) / b.baseline_units - 1 as decimal(6, 3)) as lift_vs_baseline
from daily d
join baseline b on b.dc_id = d.dc_id and b.cat_id = d.cat_id
group by 1, 2, 3, 4, b.baseline_units

model.dc_planning.mart_store_replenishme.description: Mağaza sevkiyat planı: SKU × mağaza için önerilen haftalık sevkiyat miktarı ve emniyet stoku (bölgesel DC → mağaza).
model.dc_planning.mart_store_replenishme.raw_code:
-- Mağaza sevkiyat planı: SKU × mağaza için önerilen haftalık sevkiyat miktarı (bölgesel DC → mağaza).
-- Yöntem: son 13 tam haftanın ortalama talebi + emniyet stoku (z × σ, tedarik süresi 1 hafta).
with last_week as (
    select max(wm_yr_wk) as max_wk from {{ ref('fct_sales_weekly') }} where is_complete_week
),

weeks_in_scope as (
    select distinct wm_yr_wk
    from {{ ref('fct_sales_weekly') }}, last_week
    where wm_yr_wk <= max_wk and is_complete_week
    order by wm_yr_wk desc
    limit 13
),

stats as (
    select
        w.dc_id,
        w.store_id,
        w.item_id,
        w.dept_id,
        w.cat_id,
        avg(w.units)          as avg_weekly_units,
        stddev_samp(w.units)  as std_weekly_units,
        max(w.units)          as max_weekly_units,
        sum(w.units)          as units_13w,
        sum(w.revenue)        as revenue_13w
    from {{ ref('fct_sales_weekly') }} w
    join weeks_in_scope s on s.wm_yr_wk = w.wm_yr_wk
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
)

select
    s.dc_id,
    s.store_id,
    s.item_id,
    s.dept_id,
    s.cat_id,
    z.abc_class,
    z.xyz_class,
    z.warehouse_zone,
    s.units_13w,
    cast(s.avg_weekly_units as decimal(10, 2))                                    as avg_weekly_units,
    cast(coalesce(s.std_weekly_units, 0) as decimal(10, 2))                       as std_weekly_units,
    cast(ceil({{ var('service_level_z') }} * coalesce(s.std_weekly_units, 0)) as integer) as safety_stock,
    cast(ceil(s.avg_weekly_units + {{ var('service_level_z') }} * coalesce(s.std_weekly_units, 0)) as integer)
                                                                                  as recommended_weekly_qty,
    s.max_weekly_units,
    cast(s.revenue_13w / nullif(s.units_13w, 0) as decimal(10, 2))              as avg_unit_price
from stats s
left join {{ ref('mart_sku_abc_xyz') }} z
    on z.item_id = s.item_id
   and z.dc_id = s.dc_id            -- sınıf, mağazanın bağlı olduğu bölgesel DC'nin sınıfıdır

model.dc_planning.mart_sku_abc_xyz.name: mart_sku_abc_xyz
model.dc_planning.mart_sku_abc_xyz.description: Depo yerleşimi marti: depo seviyesi (HUB, CA, TX, WI) × SKU için ABC/XYZ sınıfı, toplama sırası ve depo bölgesi (HOT/WARM/COLD).
model.dc_planning.mart_sku_abc_xyz.raw_code:
-- Depo yerleşimi: her depo seviyesi (HUB = merkez hub, CA/TX/WI = bölgesel DC) ve SKU için
-- ABC (ciro payı) × XYZ (haftalık talep düzensizliği) sınıfı, toplama sırası ve depo bölgesi.
-- Pencere: son 52 tam hafta; CV yalnızca ürünün listede olduğu haftalar üzerinden. zone_label: sıralama ön ekli Türkçe etiket. ABC/XYZ her depo seviyesinde kendi içinde hesaplanır.
with last_week as (
    select max(wm_yr_wk) as max_wk from {{ ref('fct_sales_weekly') }} where is_complete_week
),

weeks_in_scope as (
    select distinct wm_yr_wk
    from {{ ref('fct_sales_weekly') }}, last_week
    where wm_yr_wk <= max_wk and is_complete_week
    order by wm_yr_wk desc
    limit 52
),

weekly_dc as (
    select
        w.dc_id,
        w.item_id,
        w.dept_id,
        w.cat_id,
        w.wm_yr_wk,
        sum(w.units)        as units,
        sum(w.revenue)      as revenue,
        sum(w.zero_days)    as zero_days,
        sum(w.days_in_week) as days
    from {{ ref('fct_sales_weekly') }} w
    join weeks_in_scope s on s.wm_yr_wk = w.wm_yr_wk
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
),

weekly as (
    select * from weekly_dc
    union all
    select 'HUB' as dc_id, item_id, dept_id, cat_id, wm_yr_wk,
           sum(units), sum(revenue), sum(zero_days), sum(days)
    from weekly_dc
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
),

per_sku as (
    select
        dc_id,
        item_id,
        dept_id,
        cat_id,
        sum(units)                                  as units_52w,
        sum(revenue)                                as revenue_52w,
        count(*) filter (where revenue is not null) as active_weeks,   -- ürünün listede olduğu (fiyatı olan) haftalar
        avg(units)        filter (where revenue is not null) as avg_weekly_units,
        stddev_samp(units) filter (where revenue is not null) as std_weekly_units,
        sum(zero_days) * 1.0 / sum(days)            as zero_day_share
    from weekly
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4
),

ranked as (
    select
        *,
        sum(revenue_52w) over (partition by dc_id order by revenue_52w desc, units_52w desc, item_id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
            / sum(revenue_52w) over (partition by dc_id)                 as cum_revenue_share,
        std_weekly_units / nullif(avg_weekly_units, 0)                  as cv_weekly,
        row_number() over (partition by dc_id order by units_52w desc, revenue_52w desc, item_id)  as picking_rank
    from per_sku
),

classified as (
    select
        *,
        case
            when cum_revenue_share <= {{ var('abc_a_threshold') }} then 'A'
            when cum_revenue_share <= {{ var('abc_b_threshold') }} then 'B'
            else 'C'
        end as abc_class,
        case
            when cv_weekly is null then 'Z'
            when cv_weekly < {{ var('xyz_x_threshold') }} then 'X'
            when cv_weekly < {{ var('xyz_y_threshold') }} then 'Y'
            else 'Z'
        end as xyz_class
    from ranked
)

select
    dc_id,
    case when dc_id = 'HUB' then 'Merkez Hub' else dc_id || ' Bölgesel DC' end as dc_name,
    item_id,
    dept_id,
    cat_id,
    units_52w,
    cast(revenue_52w as decimal(12, 2))         as revenue_52w,
    active_weeks,
    cast(avg_weekly_units as decimal(10, 2))    as avg_weekly_units,
    cast(cv_weekly as decimal(6, 3))            as cv_weekly,
    cast(zero_day_share as decimal(5, 3))       as zero_day_share,
    cast(cum_revenue_share as decimal(6, 4))    as cum_revenue_share,
    picking_rank,
    abc_class,
    xyz_class,
    abc_class || xyz_class                      as abc_xyz,
    case
        when abc_class = 'A' and xyz_class in ('X', 'Y') then 'HOT'
        when abc_class = 'A' or (abc_class = 'B' and xyz_class in ('X', 'Y')) then 'WARM'
        else 'COLD'
    end                                         as warehouse_zone,
    case
        when abc_class = 'A' and xyz_class in ('X', 'Y') then '1. HOT'
        when abc_class = 'A' or (abc_class = 'B' and xyz_class in ('X', 'Y')) then '2. WARM'
        else '3. COLD'
    end                                         as zone_label
from classified

        count(*) filter (where revenue is not null) as active_weeks,   -- ürünün listede olduğu (fiyatı olan) haftalar
        avg(units)        filter (where revenue is not null) as avg_weekly_units,
        stddev_samp(units) filter (where revenue is not null) as std_weekly_units,
        sum(zero_days) * 1.0 / sum(days)            as zero_day_share
    from weekly
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4
),

ranked as (
    select
        *,
        sum(revenue_52w) over (partition by dc_id order by revenue_52w desc, units_52w desc, item_id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
            / sum(revenue_52w) over (partition by dc_id)                 as cum_revenue_share,
        std_weekly_units / nullif(avg_weekly_units, 0)                  as cv_weekly,
        row_number() over (partition by dc_id order by units_52w desc, revenue_52w desc, item_id)  as picking_rank
    from per_sku
),

classified as (
    select
        *,
        case
            when cum_revenue_share <= 0.8 then 'A'
            when cum_revenue_share <= 0.95 then 'B'
            else 'C'
        end as abc_class,
        case
            when cv_weekly is null then 'Z'
            when cv_weekly < 0.5 then 'X'
            when cv_weekly < 1.0 then 'Y'
            else 'Z'
        end as xyz_class
    from ranked
)

select
    dc_id,
    case when dc_id = 'HUB' then 'Merkez Hub' else dc_id || ' Bölgesel DC' end as dc_name,
    item_id,
    dept_id,
    cat_id,
    units_52w,
    cast(revenue_52w as decimal(12, 2))         as revenue_52w,
    active_weeks,
    cast(avg_weekly_units as decimal(10, 2))    as avg_weekly_units,
    cast(cv_weekly as decimal(6, 3))            as cv_weekly,
    cast(zero_day_share as decimal(5, 3))       as zero_day_share,
    cast(cum_revenue_share as decimal(6, 4))    as cum_revenue_share,
    picking_rank,
    abc_class,
    xyz_class,
    abc_class || xyz_class                      as abc_xyz,
    case
        when abc_class = 'A' and xyz_class in ('X', 'Y') then 'HOT'
        when abc_class = 'A' or (abc_class = 'B' and xyz_class in ('X', 'Y')) then 'WARM'
        else 'COLD'
    end                                         as warehouse_zone,
    case
        when abc_class = 'A' and xyz_class in ('X', 'Y') then '1. HOT'
        when abc_class = 'A' or (abc_class = 'B' and xyz_class in ('X', 'Y')) then '2. WARM'
        else '3. COLD'
    end                                         as zone_label
from classified

### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
